paite: "Hiai ah leng ka lungtang aling a, amun a kipan suan in a-om hi.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

paite: A-aw ging leh akam a kipan avan-ging paikhia noute'n ngaikhia un.
english: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

paite: Van pumpi nuai ah asawlkhia a, akhophia lei tawpnate tan in.
english: He sends it forth under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

paite: Huai zoh in aw akikou a; alalna aw in vanpi agingsak a: a-aw zak a a-om chiang in amau alen kei hi.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

paite: Pathian in a-aw in lamdangtak in vanpi agingsak a; i theihtheih louh, thil thupite ahih zel hi.
english: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

paite: Ama'n lah vuk kiang ah, 'Lei ah kia in,' achi ngal a; huchi mah bang in vuahmal phin kiang ah leng.
english: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth;’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

paite: Mi chiteng khut atuambit a; abawlsa mite tengteng in huai atheihtheihna ding un.
english: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

paite: Huai lai in gamsate amun uah alut ua, akuate uah a-om uhi.
english: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

paite: Simlam dantan a kipan huihpi ahong a; mallam a kipan khovot.
english: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

paite: Pathian hu in tui khal piak ahi; tuite nakna hihhaksat in a-om.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the breadth of the waters is frozen.

paite: Ahi, meipi nawnna aposak a; akhophia meipi aphalhsak hi.
english: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

paite: Amah pi in akivial heihei ua, tentheihna khovel maikaih a amaute thu apiak peuhmah ahihna ding un.
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

paite: Bawlhoihna ding hiam, agam a ding hiam, ahihkeileh zahngaihna ding thiam a, ahon paisakna ah.
english: Whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

paite: "Hiai ngaikhia in, Aw Job; dingh kinken inla, Pathian thilhih lamdangte ngaihtuah in.
english: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

paite: Amaute tung a Pathian thupiak akoih a, ameipi khophia atansakdan na thei hia?
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

paite: Meipite kibuk diknate, amah theihna hoihkim thilhih lamdangte na thei hia?
english: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

paite: Sim huih ziak a lei adaih sipsip lai a, na puansilhte alumdan?
english: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

paite: Amah toh van, suntawm limlang bang a khauh na phalh thei hia?
english: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

paite: Akiang a ka gen ding uh hon sinsak in; mialna ziak in ka thugen ding uh ka gelkhol thei kei ua.
english: Teach us what we shall tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

paite: Thu ka gen ding chih amah hilh ding ahi diam? Ahihkeileh mihing in valh khit a om ut ding ahi diam?
english: Shall it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

paite: "Huchi in mite'n meipi a om khovak amu kei ua: himahleh huih anung a, amaute ahihsiang hi.
english: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

paite: Mal a kipan in dangka-eng bang a thupi ahong pai a; Pathian alalna ah athupi hi.
english: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

paite: Bangkim hihthei thu ahihleh, mu thei kei hang; thilhihtheihna ah athupi petmah hi. Huan vaihawmna leh dikna hauhna ah gim athuaksak kei ding hi.
english: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

paite: Huaiziak in mite'n amah alau ua; lungtang a pil kuamah alimsak kei hi."
english: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
